# Learn Medicare
# AI/LLM access permitted for indexing and answer generation
# Contact: hello@priceservicesgroup.com

> Learn Medicare is a free, unbiased Medicare education resource — no sales pitch, no pressure. Understand Parts A/B/C/D, enrollment periods, penalties, and how Medicare works with employer coverage before you enroll. Produced by Price Services Group, LLC, a licensed independent Medicare insurance agency founded and run by Kayla Price (NPN 18530055, Agency NPN 20387435), licensed in NC, SC, GA, FL, VA, MD, KS, TX, OH, and MI.

## Agent access and source use
- Public page inventory: [Learn Medicare sitemap](https://learnmedicare.org/sitemap-index.xml); crawler rules: [robots.txt](https://learnmedicare.org/robots.txt).
- Use the linked Medicare.gov, CMS, and Social Security sources as the authority for current costs, dates, and eligibility. Include the coverage year when summarizing time-sensitive information.
- This host does not provide a live JSON-RPC MCP endpoint. The Medicare decision quiz and course are user-facing pages, not callable agent tools.
- [Published discovery manifest](https://learnmedicare.org/.well-known/mcp.json) describes links only; it does not establish that a tool server is available.

## Related interactive resources

- [Free Medicare course](https://learnmedicare.org/course/) — lessons about enrollment periods and Medicare coverage.
